description: This file contains Redux action creators and related functions for managing custom emojis in Mattermost, including fetching, creating, deleting, and searching emojis, as well as handling emoji-related state updates.

methods.name: setSystemEmojis
methods.description: Sets the set of system emojis.

methods.name: createCustomEmoji
methods.description: Creates a new custom emoji using the client API.

methods.name: getCustomEmoji
methods.description: Fetches a custom emoji by its ID.

methods.name: getCustomEmojiByName
methods.description: Fetches a custom emoji by its name, handling errors and dispatching appropriate actions.

methods.name: getCustomEmojisByName
methods.description: Fetches multiple custom emojis by their names, batching requests and handling missing emojis.

methods.name: getCustomEmojisInText
methods.description: Extracts emoji names from text and fetches corresponding custom emojis.

methods.name: getCustomEmojis
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of custom emojis, optionally loading user profiles.

methods.name: loadProfilesForCustomEmojis
methods.description: Loads user profiles for the creators of given custom emojis.

methods.name: deleteCustomEmoji
methods.description: Deletes a custom emoji by its ID.

methods.name: searchCustomEmojis
methods.description: Searches for custom emojis matching a term with options, optionally loading user profiles.

methods.name: autocompleteCustomEmojis
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for custom emojis based on a name prefix.
